title: Pink Flamingo Office Halloween Costume
intro: I wanted a Halloween costume I could actually wear to work, so I went with a flamingo. A dusty rose midi dress, a fluffy pink fascinator and little flamingo earrings, and nobody has to know it is a costume until they look closely. Most of it stays in my closet after October.

images.alt: Overhead flat lay of a pink flamingo office Halloween costume: dusty rose midi dress, pink feather fascinator, satin Mary Jane flats, pink tights, bow bag and flamingo earrings.
Mirror selfie of a woman in a dusty rose smocked midi dress with a pink feather fascinator, bow handbag, pink tights and satin flats, holding a glitter pink iced coffee tumbler.
